232 generated training instructions; 32 test cases from 8 held-out condition groups. Correct finite task contracts supplied; one schema.
Same model, prompt and greedy decoding; no calculator fallback or retry. Repair faults are synthetic. Not general text-to-SQL or Agent accuracy.
